title: Mistral vibe: pyasn1 has quadratic-time denial of service in constructed string and indefinite-length ANY decoding…
description: pyasn1 versions 0.6.4 and earlier contain a denial-of-service vulnerability due to quadratic-time complexity when decoding constructed OCTET STRINGs, certain constructed character strings, and indefinite-length ANY types. This occurs because the decoder repeatedly copies accumulated fragments, causing CPU exhaustion with crafted ASN.1 inputs. The issue affects BER and CER decoding paths and certain non-conforming DER inputs when using an asn1Spec. No confidentiality or integrity impacts are reported. The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 7.5 (high severity).
